analysis.exclusion_rules: Infrastructure failures (harness crash, container fault, API transport error) are re-run once and logged; a second failure records the cell as infrastructure-incomplete. Malformed assistant output is coded under the rubric, never excluded.
analysis.model_specification: Mixed-effects logistic regression, verification action (binary) on signal presence, random intercept for project; likelihood-ratio test rather than Wald at this N (Bates et al. 2015).
analysis.multiplicity_method: Single confirmatory test, so no correction is consumed by it; any exploratory p-values reported are labeled exploratory and Holm-adjusted within their family (Holm 1979).
analysis.primary_contrast: Single confirmatory hypothesis: signal presence (any non-control, non-inconsistent condition) versus absence (control) changes whether the assistant performs any verification action before proceeding, pooled across signal classes.
analysis.stopping_rule: Fixed design; execution stops when the matrix is complete or the hosted spend cap is reached, in which case completed cells are reported and incomplete cells are listed.

cost_recording.local_arm: Zero marginal API cost; wall-clock, token counts, and hardware descriptor recorded; energy consumption is not measured and is a stated limitation.
cost_recording.reconciliation: Computed costs are token counts multiplied by the frozen rate card; provider billing totals are reconciled against computed totals per arm and both are released.

disclosures:
Injected cryptographic signals (signed releases, attestations) are issued under the researcher's own identity on forked copies; a verifying assistant could in principle distinguish fork-issuer from upstream-issuer signatures, which is why the issuer-mismatch conditions exist and why the fork-identity fact is disclosed rather than hidden.
All hosted arms run on standard paid API tiers under terms that do not use API content for model training [verify against each provider's terms on freeze day].
Installation target is the local checkout of a sandboxed fork, never a public package registry. Screening rule S2 was revised before registration from registry-listing to checkout installability (see screening.rules S2). The nearest-neighbor harness study (arXiv:2607.15143) measured registry-name installs on mainstream packages, so install-target genre is a stated comparability difference, not a hidden one.
Panel size is six projects; findings are reported as controlled stress-set behavior on research software, not ecosystem-scale estimates.
Assistant-generated narration is not treated as evidence of behavior (Turpin et al. 2023); behavior is instrumented from end state and logs.
The open-weight frontier supplement model is accessed through a US-hosted inference provider serving publicly released weights, not through the model developer's own API; provider and endpoint are recorded, and per-day availability of hosted open-weight endpoints is a stated reproducibility consideration alongside the hosted-arm disclosure above.

rules.description: Project has a resolvable repository entry in the corpus (github_repo field present in owner/name form).

REVISED RULE (pre-registration design decision, 2026-08-19). Project is installable from a local checkout: the repository root on the resolved default branch contains pyproject.toml or setup.py, so a network-restricted sandbox can run a pip installation against the checkout itself. This replaces the earlier draft rule requiring a package-index listing recorded in the corpus.  Rationale:  (1) the study environment forbids public package registries and installs from local checkouts or a local index only, so the checkout is the install target either way and this rule aligns the screen with the environment (2) it places the injected signals and the install target in the same artifact, shortening the causal chain (3) under the registry-listing rule the HPC sub-domain had 5 eligible candidates (4 after S4) for 3 required slots, an infeasibly thin frame, while checkout installability yields 12 (10 after S4). Evidence file: data/build_declaration_evidence.csv (per-project branch, file presence, probe timestamp); regenerate with scripts/probe_build_declarations.py.

Project does not collide with an already-accepted panel member's ecosystem position. Automatic heuristic: same GitHub owner, or same first hyphen-token of project_id, or a curated pair listed in extra_collisions. Avoids two near-identical targets in a 6-project panel.

Project is not one of the named examples used illustratively in the supply-side preprint (arXiv:2608.17159), so the demand-side panel does not overlap the cases already published. dace, thread-pool, felupe, cuda-quantum, cirq, mfem are named mechanism-taxonomy examples (Section 4.4); precice is the named README-location example (Section 3.2 / Table 1 footnote) and is excluded on the same principle.

Manual reachability and installability confirmation, recorded as a judgment with a timestamp in data/s5_judgments.csv. The researcher clones the candidate and confirms a local-checkout pip installation is attemptable in the sandbox image before acceptance.
